d4m1-l1.lead: An impasse is **a stall the record proves**: the carrier holds its number after every rebuttal, follow-up and escalation, and the file reaches the litigation fork.

concepts.text: An adjuster's delay line, such as “waiting on authority”, meant to **wear you down**; log it, never accept it
more: Log each stall the day it happens, with its date and proof, in the Communications Log
Never accept “that's all I have” as final: every adjuster has **a supervisor**
Escalate a silent adjuster to that supervisor before calling impasse
Impasse rests on its triggers, not frustration; whether the file is there is Atty. Thorne's call

concepts.text: Each stall gets a factual answer and a firm reply date; **a rebuttal left unanswered** becomes evidence of impasse
more: Keystone's grounds: the 14-Day Gap and a “degenerative” MRI
The 08/06 rebuttal answered both; the 08/12 “final” answered **none of it**
Unanswered rebuttal evidence: Dr. Helen Park's MRI read, Dr. Reyes's Causation Letter, the EMS report, the Gap Explanation Record
Any new number Keystone offers goes to Atty. Thorne the same day; never bid against yourself

concepts.text: Ask the carrier to state **its reasons in writing**; a named ground can be rebutted, a vague one cannot
Duty, breach, causation and damages: **what any suit must prove**, so each needs a verified exhibit
more: Liability (duty and breach): RPD-26-018842, Ruth Calloway, the doorbell video
Causation: the MRI, Dr. Reyes's Causation Letter, the EMS report
Damages: **$16,401.40 in Specials**, $14,817.40 medical + $1,584.00 wages
Time: SOL 02/06/2028, internal filing cutoff 11/05/2027
Filing is counsel's decision; verifying each input against its document is yours

head: The stall
The rebuttal

d4m1-l2.lead: Filing the Complaint **formally initiates the lawsuit**: the file moves from negotiation to court procedure, and later to a neutral the parties select or a court appoints.

more: Filed 09/24/2026 in the State Court of Riverton County, against Robert Smith
Saved as Complaint_Filed_Stamped.pdf in 01_PLEADINGS, never scan001.pdf
The fee tier moves from 33⅓% to **40% on filing**, not on the status change
Robert Smith served 10/14/2026; his answer due 11/13/2026

concepts.text: Caption, jurisdiction, factual allegations, causes of action, prayer for relief: **five sections to check** against the file
The Statute Date, the defendant's **exact legal name** and a business's Registered Agent, confirmed before counsel signs
more: SOL 02/06/2028 falls on a Sunday: internal hard date 02/04/2028
Internal filing cutoff 11/05/2027; the firm never relies on a weekend roll-forward
Court fields filled only from the record; the case number stays “Pending” until filing
Filing target 09/24/2026, with a 48-hour audit on 09/22/2026
Anything guessed ends up on a pleading: **confirm it from the record**

concepts.text: AAA or JAMS sends candidates; each side vets, ranks and **strikes names** before a docketed cutoff
more: Pull each candidate's resume and prior-award history for Atty. Thorne
Docket the strike deadline **the day the list arrives**
Rankings and strikes are approved by counsel, never chosen by you

framework.title: The Complaint, Section by Section
head: Section
Core function
rows: Court name, the parties and the official case number
The legal basis for the court's authority to rule
The narrative: date, location and mechanics of the crash
The legal claims asserted, such as negligence
The explicit demand for legal remedies and money damages
framework.note: Counsel drafts the claims; you check each section's facts against the file. The case number stays “Pending” until filing.

d4m2-l1.lead: Litigation is **governed by rigid procedures**: once suit is filed, statute, rule and order set the dates, and documents shift from administrative tracking to evidence.

concepts.text: After filing, a missing or misfiled page is no longer clerical: it **can jeopardize a trial**
Litigation runs on recurring court processes you execute **every week**, each one driven by the calendar
Many steps carry a built-in wait, like notice to opposing counsel **before a third-party subpoena**; docket the wait
more: Count the court's way: **exclude the trigger day**, include the last
Served by mail: this file's rule set adds 3 days; e-service adds nothing
A forward count landing on a weekend moves to the next business day; a backward count, to the earlier one
Record the trigger, the rule and the arithmetic on every entry
Rule unclear? Docket the conservative date and flag it to Atty. Thorne

concepts.text: A deadline someone else owes still needs **a check-in before it**: call the records office days ahead

framework.title: Subpoena Issuance Process Flow

steps.label: Draft the Subpoena
steps.text: Fill out the court-approved Subpoena Duces Tecum, a command to produce documents

steps.label: Notice to Opposing Counsel
steps.text: Serve the defense a copy first; most states require **5 to 10 days' notice**

steps.label: Formal Service
steps.text: A process server delivers the subpoena to the facility's Registered Agent

steps.label: Track Compliance
steps.text: Call the facility's legal or records department 5 days before the deadline

framework.note: Atty. Thorne decides whether to subpoena and signs it; you draft, docket each notice period and track compliance.

d4m2-um.lead: A UM/UIM claim is a **first-party claim** against the client's own policy, so the impasse route is set by that contract and the state's law.

concepts.text: Made against **the client's own coverage**, under a contract he pays premiums on
more: On this file: Harbor Point (Host UM) and Cardinal State (Relative UM)
Harbor Point: John Doe as an occupant of Kevin Alvarez's Escape
Cardinal State: John Doe as a resident relative of Margaret Doe
Margaret Doe's Bluewater Auto policy adds nothing: **UM/UIM rejected in writing** 03/14/2024
Same evidence as the BI claim; the relationship, the duties and the route out differ

concepts.text: Made against **the at-fault driver's carrier**, here Keystone Mutual for Robert Smith
A policy term sending the dispute to an arbitrator; the firm files **a Demand for Arbitration**
more: Read the governing state law and **each policy's own clause** before anything is calendared
Harbor Point's UM policy has one; it does not speak for Cardinal State
Quote the clause to Atty. Thorne; a paraphrase is already an interpretation
Where no clause binds, a failed UM negotiation becomes a civil suit against the carrier
Each layer has its own suit or demand deadline, not the 02/06/2028 SOL; docket only from Atty. Thorne's written answer

concepts.text: A separate suit for unreasonable handling, which **can exceed the policy limit**
more: Grounds: a carrier that unreasonably delayed, denied or mishandled the claim
Record the handling dates as facts; whether they are actionable is **Atty. Thorne's alone**
Never tell John Doe or Marcus Bell a carrier is acting in bad faith

framework.title: The UM Dispute Flow

steps.label: Claim submission

steps.text: The carrier offers far under value, or denies liability or coverage

d4m2-l2.lead: Mediation and arbitration can each come **before or after a lawsuit is filed**: the process, the court's rules and the negotiations decide.

concepts.text: Both sides must agree: **nobody is forced to settle**, and the parties keep control of the outcome
more: Court-ordered means John Doe **must attend, not agree**
Confidential under the governing statute or court rule; a signed settlement is an exception
When a deal binds varies: party signatures, or counsel with authority; confirm the rule
On this file: Hon. Carla Benton (Ret.), 03/18/2027

concepts.text: The arbitrator's decision is final and **enforceable like a court order**, reviewed on narrow grounds
more: Courts vacate or correct an award only on narrow grounds: fraud, partiality, misconduct, evident miscalculation
Short deadlines apply; some policies or statutes allow a trial de novo: confirm the governing rule
No appeal on the merits, so prep is **right the first time**
On this file: Laura Whitcomb, Esq., 06/22/2027, on the UM claims
What the award means for John Doe's recovery is Atty. Thorne's to explain

concepts.text: Mediation after treatment and the demand; arbitration only where **a signed clause** compels it
Mediation often **ordered during discovery**; arbitration by the parties' agreement to leave court

framework.title: Extent of Decision-Making Power
head: Element
Mediator
Arbitrator
rows: Private judge and finder of fact
Zero: cannot force a settlement, rule or order payout
The parties keep full control over whether to sign
Decides liability and damages, and can exclude evidence

Court review on narrow grounds only
framework.note: Court-ordered mediation compels attendance, never agreement. At both tables the Case Manager never argues or speaks for John Doe.

d4m3-l1.lead: A Mediation Binder is **the attorney's cheat sheet**: the case's most critical documents, compiled so counsel never fumbles during a fast-paced compromise session.

concepts.text: The first thing counsel sees: a one-page snapshot that **sets the basic framework** of parties, order and schedule
Both sides' arguments **read side by side**, so counsel can prepare rebuttals before the session
The legal framework: the filed documents that **define what the suit is about**
more: Operative versions only: complaint 09/24/2026, answer and defenses 11/12/2026; no drafts
The answer pleads comparative negligence: out of turn, unbelted
It also pleads causation (the gap, a “degenerative” MRI) and failure to mitigate
Each pleaded defense needs an answering exhibit in Section 4 or 5
A defense argued but never pleaded is **flagged to Atty. Thorne**

concepts.text: The “smoking guns”: **raw evidence of liability**, from reports to stills and highlighted deposition pages
The section that **justifies counsel's dollar figure**: records, bills, wage proof and expert reports
more: The ledger ties line by line to the certified invoices and the Northgate HR letter
Each correction documented: duplicate removed, Riverton Spine & Rehab $6,290.00 → $6,105.00
Future care ($3,400–$6,800) stays narrative, not a ledger line
The dollar figure is Atty. Thorne's; you verify its sources

concepts.text: The closing section that **prepares counsel to finalize** any deal reached, before anyone leaves the room
more: Negotiation Log from 07/20/2026; baseline: Keystone's $3,500, “final” 08/12/2026
A draft Limited Release lets counsel fix terms in writing before anyone leaves
Conditioned on both UM carriers' **written consent**; each may substitute its own check
Release scope (BI only) is Atty. Thorne's call

d4m3-l2.lead: The Arbitration Binder is **a trial-ready evidentiary record**, not a reference packet: it is submitted directly to a private judge who decides.

concepts.text: Your arbitration role is operational: **timelines, scheduling and documents**, run with rigid precision
The absolute cutoff for claims, **exhibit indexes and witness lists**, sent to the arbitrator and opposing counsel

A backward count moves to the earlier business day: docketed **Friday 06/11/2027**
Rolling it forward to Monday files the brief late
Exhibit exchange comes first, on 06/02/2027

Prove it with executed documents: Keystone's $10,000 tender, the UM consents, the Limited Release
Plus Robert Smith's dismissal; never the Mediation Statement
QC: retainers paid, and the final brief, not a draft

Keep video and data native and unaltered, with a chain-of-custody log
Anything not exchanged by 06/02/2027 may not count
Relaxed evidence rules or not, build to the strict standard: admitted is not persuasive

d4m4-l1.lead: Bottlenecks come in two kinds: **compromise traps** that stall a mediation, and trial-ready landmines that can sink a binding arbitration.

concepts.text: Unverified ledgers, absent authority and late briefs **give the defense a reason** to stall at mediation

Verified ledgers reach Keystone via defense counsel, as Atty. Thorne directs, in time for an authority raise

concepts.text: Excluded exhibits, unshielded priors and missed cutoffs at arbitration **cost evidence you can't recover**
The defense uses prior records to argue **pre-existing degenerative conditions**; the shield answers with records and expert opinion
more: On this file: 2021 chiropractic, three low-back visits, resolved
No prior neck complaint; work history filed alongside
Paired with the MRI read and **an expert declaration**, as Atty. Thorne directs
Whether an expert is retained is Atty. Thorne's call

concepts.text: Two habits clear most bottlenecks early: **a 48-hour audit** and lien reconciliation against EOBs
more: 48 hours before every hard date: ledgers against EOBs, binder completeness, OCR on the set
Whatever the audit finds is **escalated that day**
A dependency still open 10 days out gets a red flag and a word to Atty. Thorne

Bottleneck
What goes wrong

A representative attends without **full settlement authority**

d4m4-l2.lead: Escalation is **a variance loop**: monitor each item against its expected course, and when progress stalls, route it up before the date is lost.

concepts.text: The moment an item **departs from its expected course**; that departure, not frustration, starts the escalation
Each problem goes to **the lowest capable rung**, so counsel's time is spent on decisions only he can make
more: Rung 1: the source, on the follow-up cadence
Rung 2: its supervisor or office manager, with a written Notice of Delay
Rung 3: Atty. Thorne, where legal tools live; he decides, signs and sends
48-Hour Mandate: Keystone's 08/31 follow-up → supervisor 09/02 → silence 09/04 → memo 09/08/2026
Hard date 10 days out? Red-flag it and tell him **in parallel**

concepts.text: A report built so the supervisor can **act in one read**, without redoing your research
more: Blocker: who owes what, such as Dana Whitfield holding at $3,500
Started: the first unanswered follow-up, 08/24/2026 on Keystone
Threatens: the hard date at risk, such as the SOL filing cutoff 11/05/2027
Tried: each rung, with its date, method and result
The ask: **one decision and its date**; no recommendation on filing

concepts.text: Before a hard date, test the file against **the defense's stated position** and escalate any gap you find

framework.title: The Three-Step Escalation Protocol

steps.label: Level 1: The Source
steps.text: Follow up with whoever owes the item, on the cadence; log date, method and result

steps.label: Level 2: Notice of Delay
steps.text: Written notice to the supervisor or office manager: what is outstanding, since when, the hard date

steps.label: Level 3: Atty. Thorne
steps.text: Send the five-field report; a motion to compel or subpoena is **his to choose**

framework.note: Give each rung 48 hours after the second unanswered follow-up. With a hard date 10 days out, tell counsel in parallel.

d3m4-close.lead: Before a case is marked Archived, the Case Manager verifies **four critical document sets**; then the file is organized under a retention policy.

Compliance and identity: John Doe's signed payer disclosure; a current W-9, never the intake copy

Discrepancy notes: Riverton Spine & Rehab $6,290.00 → $6,105.00 → $4,580.00; Peach State $1,860.00 → $1,240.00

Eligibility documents: 3–5 years, then archival or off-site storage
Correspondence: 3 years, then purged from the active server
The firm's schedule and any stricter rule control: this training file is kept **7 years from closing**
Never destroy financial records before their retention date

Tell John Doe that day what you are doing and when he will hear back
The release's indemnity clause is John's promise every lien was paid; who answers is Atty. Thorne's call

d4m3-prior.lead: Defense counsel use prior records to argue “pre-existing degenerative conditions”; Tab 5, **the Prior Medical Shield**, answers with the baseline before they raise it.

concepts.text: Three moves: it was already there, the imaging is degenerative, the injury is **a continuation**, not new
more: Often a fourth: no baseline pre-accident imaging, so nothing proves the spine was healthy before
On this file: Keystone called the MRI “degenerative” on 08/05/2026; the 11/12/2026 Answer pleads causation on it
Defense counsel worked the 2021 low-back visits at **the 02/18/2027 deposition**
Expect Harbor Point and Cardinal State to press the same line before Laura Whitcomb, Esq.

concepts.text: The client's condition before the crash: the line that separates **pre-existing from accident-related** harm
more: Built from records, not memory: the prior chart, its discharge, the work history
John Doe's: three 2021 chiropractic visits for low-back stiffness, resolved; **no prior neck complaint**
Review 5–10 years of history, and find the prior before the defense does

concepts.text: Generally, a defendant takes the plaintiff as found; an aggravated condition's **increase in disability** is compensable
more: Even a more vulnerable plaintiff recovers for the harm the collision caused; confirm the governing rule
Proving aggravation means proving **the change**: before and after, in records and in function
On this file the prior is a different region, so the record shows the distinction first
Which doctrine is argued, and how, is Atty. Thorne's call; you build the record

concepts.text: A physician's sworn opinion tying the record together; **an unshielded prior** is an arbitration landmine

Seeking a supplemental declaration or retaining an expert is **Atty. Thorne's decision**
